objective: Cross-dataset measurement of mining hash computation and its relationship with obfuscation mechanisms and static code changes
research_questions: Which obfuscation mechanisms are supported by evidence in each public mining corpus?
How do verified obfuscation mechanisms and static structural changes relate to hash throughput and correctness?
Which relationships reproduce across distinct mining implementations and datasets, and where do they differ?

prior_work.name: Cryptic Bytes
prior_work.current_role: Reproduction/control and cross-dataset comparison; not first hash-rate evaluation

prior_work.name: WebAssembly Diversification for Malware Evasion
prior_work.evidence: Sections 5.3 and 6.3, Table 4; pool validity and nominal 1000-second rate measurements
prior_work.current_role: Methodological reference; recovered inputs retain reconstruction limitations

prior_work.name: Proof-of-Theft
prior_work.evidence: Main paper Section 6 RQs concern graph simplification and miner detection; supplementary.pdf (2 pages) contains theorem proof and graph examples. Artifact includes hashrate.js in cryptonight-hash baseline and obfuscated directories, so runtime measurement capability exists. Reviewed paper/supplement/README and artifact path inventory do not establish a published paired throughput/correctness result.
prior_work.current_role: Priority 1: measure paired original and obfuscated uninstrumented modules, with verified hash outputs and algorithm-specific throughput; do not claim hashing was never run.

prior_work.name: SWAMPED
prior_work.evidence: Section IV.D / Table III: 74 samples, Node 22.19.0, Liftoff baseline JIT, no-op imported functions because JS artifacts absent, 1000 warm-up calls plus median of 100 calls per exported function. This is execution-time overhead, not a demonstrated complete mining hash throughput/output-validity benchmark. Public experimental_results tree lists detector scores and heat maps.
prior_work.current_role: Priority 2: restore supported hashing host interfaces for cryptomining subset, then evaluate complete valid hashing; published seeds/transforms must be distinguished from our own generated variants.

prior_work.name: MinerRay
prior_work.evidence: Section 6.4 / Table 5 evaluates detector graph construction and scanning time/memory. Public README describes crawled Wasm samples and detection results. No paired obfuscation hashing-throughput benchmark identified in reviewed main paper/README/public file inventory.
prior_work.current_role: Collected-code extension; check overlap with earlier mining papers and source/algorithm evidence before calling a binary newly evaluated.

prior_work.name: MineSweeper
prior_work.evidence: Section 6 / Table 10 reports Wasm vs asm.js hash rates on two CPUs and estimates throttling/profit impacts. This is not a systematic paired comparison of obfuscation methods over the whole released corpus.
prior_work.current_role: Previously evaluated reference with potential additional sample/method coverage; not an unevaluated dataset.

metrics: hashes per second with actual sample timestamps
baseline-relative throughput where pairing is verified
verified outputs or pool share acceptance/rejection
static code structure, instructions and size already measured
execution_conditions: Do not execute collection websites or original mining HTML blindly; invoke only reviewed hashing functions in the isolated runtime.
Retain source algorithms and input bytes. A compatible public pool is required for claims of pool validity.
Local-only hash measurements require source-supported inputs and an independent correctness reference; never call them pool acceptance.
Compare within algorithm and implementation; absolute rates of different algorithms do not measure obfuscation overhead.
Retain raw, missing and failed results. No fabricated results or unsupported novelty claims.
No external attacks, scanning, unauthorized mining, donation traffic, secret keys or Windows protection changes.
app_goal_replacement: create_goal rejected because the old goal is unfinished. New authorized objective saved to experiments/runtime-reference/cross-dataset-goal.txt; old goal not marked complete.
completion_status: incomplete; do not replace full objective with these preliminary completed runs

novelty_audit.status: Documented evaluation gaps within the reviewed primary sources; worldwide first-evaluation claim not established
novelty_audit.primary_addition: Paired, correctness-verified complete hashing throughput for published obfuscated miners, extending detection-focused datasets and stub-based runtime evaluations
requirements: Verify dataset variants are not identical to already benchmarked binaries.
Separate Wasabi instrumentation overhead from obfuscation overhead.
Same algorithm/input/runtime/threads within pairs; repeat and report variation.
Without an original pair, report absolute hashing results but do not call a difference obfuscation overhead.
Do not infer absence of all earlier hashing runs from absence of a paper section.
